title: Backup
hint: Export all your data (tracked accounts, history, follower list, settings) to a file, to import it again after reinstalling or on another computer. The file contains your follower list: keep it private.
confirmText: Import “{{file}}”? All current xGhost data will be replaced with the backup’s.
imported: Backup imported: xGhost is back to the backup’s state

errors.invalid: This file isn’t a valid xGhost backup: nothing was changed
errors.newer: This backup comes from a newer version of xGhost: update the extension first
errors.too-large: This file is too large to be an xGhost backup
errors.failed: Import failed: your data was not changed
